backbones
the backbone
the backbones

☛ Option 3 & 4 (the backbone/the backbones) are incorrect as there’s no specific reference to any backbone.

Plural nouns are used when they match plural subjects without any specific reference.

His friend did not return even the next day, or the day after. For several days, the partridge (1)______ worrying, and then gave up (2)______ of his friend's return.(3)______ dusk, a hare came to the tree and (4)______ an empty hole at the foot of the tree, (5)______ shelter inside. Since the partridge had given up hope, he did not object to the hole being occupied by the hare.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
options_hi: looking
noting
seeing
watching
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है "seeing"

Explanation:
☛ Contextual Fit: यहाँ 'seeing' सबसे उपयुक्त है क्योंकि यह एक casual observation (सामान्य अवलोकन) को दर्शाता है। "a hare came to the tree and saw an empty hole" में, खरगोश ने बिना किसी विशेष ध्यान के गड्ढे को देखा।
☛ Grammar Rule: 'Seeing' एक present participle है जो simultaneous action (समकालिक क्रिया) दिखाता है। यहाँ खरगोश के आने और गड्ढे को देखने की घटना एक साथ घटित हो रही है।
☛ Other Options:
- Looking (जानबूझकर देखना): यहाँ कोई intentional effort नहीं है।
- Noting (ध्यान से देखना): Context में कोई विशेष ध्यान नहीं दिया गया।
- Watching (लगातार निगरानी करना): यहाँ कोई prolonged observation नहीं है।

Exam Tip: Cloze tests में verbs of perception (देखने/सुनने की क्रियाएँ) के बीच अंतर समझें। 'See' का प्रयोग unintentional (अनैच्छिक) देखने के लिए होता है, जबकि 'look/watch' में intention होता है।

Consumption of junk and fast food is the main (1)______ of obesity in teenagers. Large intake of high-calorie and low-nutrient food leads to (2)______ weight gain. A number of health issues arise out of it. Obesity can also result in (3)______ problems like low self-esteem and low confidence. It can also lead to laziness and in activeness among teens. Junk food and soft drinks should be (4)______ with lots of fruits, vegetables and whole grains in the diet. The best way to control obesity is to do (5)______ physical exercise.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
options: result
cause
effect
event
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "cause"

Explanation:
☛ The correct answer is "cause" because it establishes a cause-effect relationship between "Consumption of junk food" and "obesity in teenagers".
☛ "Cause" means 'a reason' or 'source', indicating that junk food is the primary reason behind obesity.
☛ Other options like "result", "effect", or "event" are incorrect as they describe outcomes, not the origin.
☛ Grammatically, "cause" is a noun that fits perfectly with the adjective "main" in the sentence structure.
☛ This answer is exam-critical as it helps students identify cause-effect based questions accurately.
